## Your turn: draw the path

The cell membrane is made of proteins and lipids. On paper, draw part of a cell and show how these materials reach the membrane:

- Draw the rough ER and the smooth ER beside the nucleus.
- Draw the Golgi apparatus as a stack of curved sacs.
- Draw a vesicle leaving the Golgi apparatus.
- Draw the cell membrane at the edge, with the vesicle joining it.

Label each part, and join them with arrows in the right order.
